{{Top}}
[[File:C9979_ep1ig.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] travelled at 587 kilometers per hour]]
The '''kilometer per hour''',<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|business/13228_1.html|No Frills, No Thrills: The Mobquet A-1 Deluxe}}</ref> often abbreviated as '''kph''',<ref name="HNN2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|weather.html|Weather Report}}</ref> '''KMH''',<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> '''km/h''',<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> or '''km/hr''',<ref name="RFU">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref> was a physical unit of speed or velocity, expressing the number of [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] traveled in one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|vehicle|sebulbaspodracer|Podracer, Sebulba's}}</ref>

Kilometers per hour were often used to express the speed of vehicles, such as [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]], [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]], [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], and even [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Fast ground-based vehicles such as the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]] used by [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout troopers]] had a maximum speed of 500 km/h.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]], which were designed for high-speed races, had higher maximum speeds. Young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]] had a maximum speed of 947 km/h.<ref name="FF">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 2|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 2]]</ref>
